problems.text: kmctl's repository has no agent that answers questions on issues and pull requests or triages new issues.
A Hermes triage comment can run to thousands of words, too long to read on every issue.

goals.text: Members get answers and triage on kmctl's own issues and pull requests without leaving GitHub.

outcomes.change: /hermes answers a member's comment on an issue or pull request
outcomes.checked_by: tests/scripts/test_workflows.py checks the trigger, the member gate, the trusted checkout and SHA pins

outcomes.change: New issues get a triage comment under 200 tokens and allowed labels
outcomes.checked_by: tests/scripts/test_hermes_triage.py runs the script on long and labelled responses

outcomes.change: An ADR records why kmctl's repository runs Hermes beside action/agent.py
